VALIDATION_RESULTS: E2E pipeline validation against PR #25

PR: #25 (feat: Merge-safe ticket IDs and concurrent-edit hardening)
Lines changed: 7595 (distinct from PR #37, out-of-sample)
Tier: deep (SIZE_WARNING: 3846 lines at deep threshold)
Total findings: 7 (1 critical, 4 important, 2 minor)

PRE-REGISTERED INVALIDITY CRITERIA:
1. Asserts code behavior contradicted by visible diff
2. Cites a line that does not exist in the diff
3. Asserts a bug about code not visible in the diff when REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci was present

TRIAGE:
[1] CRITICAL (correctness) pre-commit-ticket-gate.sh — backward compat regex break: VALID. Specific code pattern change in named file; plausible regression in ticket hardening PR.
[2] IMPORTANT (correctness) agent-batch-lifecycle.sh — stderr discarded by pipe change: VALID. Specific pattern change (2>&1 | tr -d to 2>/dev/null | tail -1); confirmed behavior regression.
[3] IMPORTANT (design) ticket-migrate-schema-hardening.sh — dual-lock TOCTOU gap: VALID. Design concern about fcntl lock released when Python exits before mkdir lock acquired.
[4] IMPORTANT (hygiene) ticket-create.sh — temp file not cleaned on early exit: VALID. Specific variable (_alias_stderr) and named file; cleanup gap is real.
[5] IMPORTANT (design) check-tickets-boundary-allowlist.conf — overly broad tests/** glob: VALID. Configuration change with documented behavioral consequence.

RESULT: 0 of 5 important/critical findings determined invalid. All findings reference visible diff content and cite plausible behavior regressions.

OBSERVATION: All 7 findings were missing the cited_lines field despite agent instructions (T2-T6). The validate-review-output.sh gate (T7) correctly enforces cited_lines at commit time. LLM compliance with cited_lines instruction is a follow-up concern (filed separately as 6da2-4cff gap).
